description: This file implements a process monitoring system in C, including process supervision, signal handling, counters for detecting stuck processes, and process restart logic.

methods.name: mon_start
methods.description: Starts the process monitor, forks a child process to supervise, and handles process restart logic.

methods.name: mon_process_wait
methods.description: Waits for a process or process group to terminate within a timeout.

methods.name: mon_process_terminate
methods.description: Attempts to terminate a process group gracefully with SIGTERM, then forcefully with SIGKILL.

methods.name: mon_check_process
methods.description: Checks if a child process is still alive or has exited, and determines the cause of exit.

methods.name: mon_check_counter
methods.description: Checks counters to detect if the child process is stuck; sends SIGABRT if a counter is frozen.

methods.name: mon_checkin
methods.description: Increments a monitoring counter, recording the source file, line, and thread ID.
